name: Gelatinous Cube
body:
Gelatinous cubes represent a rare, sentient, and mentally awakened juvenile offshoot of dungeon-scouring oozes. Though unable to speak conventional mortal tongues, their transparent cubic bodies, digestive secretions, and alien biology make them an eccentric and devastatingly durable option on the adventuring trail.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Gelatinous cubes are physiologically robust, but share the diminished mental and social traits common to oozes. They gain +4 Constitution, -2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Ooze. Gelatinous cubes eat and breathe, but do not sleep. They are genderless. They gain armor and weapon proficiencies based on class.
Size: Medium. Gelatinous cubes are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Speed: Very Slow Speed. Gelatinous cubes have a base speed of 15 feet.
Languages: Gelatinous cubes cannot speak, but understand Common. They communicate with other gelatinous cubes within range of their blindsight through pheromones and subtle visual displays. Cubes with high Intelligence scores can understand additional bonus languages of their choice.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Blind (Ex): Gelatinous cubes are blind, granting complete immunity to gaze attacks, visual effects, illusions, and other attack forms that rely on sight.
Blindsight (Ex): Gelatinous cubes possess blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.
Ooze Immunities (Ex): Gelatinous cubes are immune to electricity, paralysis, poison, polymorph effects, sleep effects, and stunning. They are not subject to critical hits or flanking, and take no additional damage from precision-based attacks like sneak attack.
Not Quite Mindless (Ex): Awakened gelatinous cube player characters are not mindless, gaining a +4 racial bonus on saving throws against all mind-affecting effects.
Transparent (Ex): Gelatinous cubes have a lack of coloration that makes them difficult to discern. A DC 15 Perception check is required to notice a motionless gelatinous cube.
Offense and Biology Racial Traits
Acid (Ex): A gelatinous cube exudes digestive acid dealing 1d4 points of acid damage. This acid damages any creature or object hit by the cube’s slam attack, grappled by the cube, or otherwise in contact with it. A gelatinous cube’s acid does not harm metal or stone.
Natural Weapon: A gelatinous cube has a primary slam natural attack that deals 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage plus acid.
Cube Physiology (Ex): Gelatinous cubes have no standard magic item slots and cannot normally wear, hold, or wield items. They can absorb objects into their body mass as easily as another creature picks an item up, sharing the carrying capacity of a humanoid of equal Strength. Helpless or willing creatures that the cube can completely cover can be absorbed and carried; however, they gain the pinned condition, risk suffocation, and take the cube’s acid damage each round. Due to their shape, cubes occupy their entire square and cannot be tripped.
